docs.title: Welcome to the CherryHub
docs.text: I'm a mathematics student at the University of Leipzig and teacher / tutor. This is a website for showcasing computational projects and a place where I blog about mathematics for anyone interested in my work.

docs.title: Coding projects
docs.text:
I work on various projects involving programming. Mostly, I write in Python, but I also frequently write solutions in Julia. When new stuff is made, you can see it showcased here.

  • The CherryBot Discord Bot - Multi-purpose bot tool for Discord
  • Orbital - Julia Simulation of Planetary Orbits

docs.title: Math articles
docs.text:
I use this site to post blogs about mathematics. Coming soon, you might also find film theory here. Check out my article on the Calculus of Variations:

The Elegance of Variational Calculus, 5 min read

docs.title: Who I am
docs.text: My name is Cherry and I am a german mathematician and teacher. I specialize in developing solutions for computational problems and communicating higher academical mathematics. This website is my personal portfolio for projects I have made as well as a place to publish articles about interesting pieces of math. Feel free to read my work or just see the abstracts to know what it's about. If there's anything you'd like to talk about, feel free to hit me up. I'm always available to chat about my work or take suggestions / error reports.

docs.title: How to contact me
docs.text: I always love talking about my work. No matter what for. You can best reach me through my personal Discord. So, if you can message me there, do that. Otherwise, you can reach me via mail. (The address will be available here soon!) Alternatively, just tag me on Mastodon.
